issues: 灰底小字 prompt 条 + 灰色骨架块，整屏像线框图，读不出生成了什么
前 2 秒只有画面顶上一条 prompt，下方大片空白
连线只是灰色细线跟着节点出现，"线牵出节点"的因果看不见
节点从中心缩放弹出，像弹窗而不是从结构里长出来
成树后没有落点，结尾画面平
changes: look 换 aurora 深紫夜：prompt 条做成 36px 大字 AI 命令条，提交后描边变流动紫粉渐变（生成中），完成后右侧落「7 tables · 6 links」
相机：开场 1.3× 推近 prompt 居中读字，提交后 72f smooth 拉远到 1.0，树长在镜头退出来的空间里
每条连线带一颗发光彗星头领跑（SVG 圆弧折线，按弧长取点），线头到达子端口那一帧子节点才从顶端口被拉出（缩放原点 = 顶边中点）
prompt 底部先滴下一条虚线接到根节点，根用紫粉渐变描边 + 泛光当主角；其余为深紫玻璃 ER 表卡（34px 表名 + mono 字段 + PK/FK 签）
打字改为不均匀人手节奏、空格停半拍；成树后以树心呼吸 1→1.03→1、背后极光亮一档，时长 160→180f
issuesEn: A small grey prompt bar over grey skeleton blocks; the whole frame looks like a wireframe and doesn't say what was generated
For the first 2 seconds there is only one prompt line at the top and a large empty area below
Edges are thin grey lines that appear with the nodes; the "line pulls the node out" causality isn't visible
Nodes scale up from their centre, reading like pop-ups rather than growing out of the structure
Once the tree is complete there is no landing beat; the end frame is flat
changesEn: Aurora deep-violet look: the prompt is a 36px AI command bar whose border turns into a flowing violet-pink gradient while generating, then settles with "7 tables · 6 links"
Camera opens at 1.3× on the centred prompt to read it, then smoothly pulls back to 1.0 over 72f after submit, so the tree grows into the space the camera reveals
Each edge is led by a glowing comet head (SVG arc elbows, sampled by arc length); the child node is pulled out of its top port the frame the head arrives (scale origin = top edge centre)

A dashed drip line falls from the prompt into the root; the root has a violet-pink gradient rim and glow as the hero, the rest are dark violet glass ER cards (34px table name, mono fields, PK/FK tags)
Typing has an uneven human rhythm with pauses at spaces; the finished tree breathes 1→1.03→1 around its centre while the aurora behind it brightens; 160→180f
